hints.title: Coordinate Sorting
hints.text: Sort robots by spatial position to encounter collisions in chronological physical order.

hints.title: Rightward Robot Tracking
hints.text: Maintain moving right robots in a sequential container ready to collide with oncoming left robots.

hints.title: Health Decimation Rules
hints.text: When opposing robots meet, the one with lower health is destroyed and the other loses one health point.

hints.title: Stack Collision Code

complexity.notes: Sorting positions dominates; each robot is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating minute time steps is intractable for coordinates up to 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models robot collisions via position sorting and stack reduction.
